svg.title: Fork vs upstream CodeGraph: every result
svg.desc: Heatmap of the fork's change against upstream for full index time, peak memory and one-file sync on seven repositories, the MCP server on n8n and gin, and command-line startup. Of 76 comparisons it is better in 56, about the same in 5 and worse in 15.
svg.text: Each cell is the fork’s change versus upstream. Negative is better (less time or memory). Green = better beyond the comparison’s own run-to-run spread, amber = inside it, red = worse, grey = inconclusive or no data.
Measured 2026-10-27 · upstream 69af19ac vs fork bc27fdb4 · Node 24.22.1, Bun 1.4.4 · 16-vCPU WSL2 · two runs per arm, median · fork on Node unless noted
